## Experience

- **Founder & CEO — Mx Solution** (Jan 2025 – Present, https://www.mxsolution.in)
  Founded a technology studio that solves business problems with technology,
  from websites and e-commerce to custom software, automation and SEO. Shipped
  platforms for Guidance Tamil Nadu (Government of Tamil Nadu), SK Attire Hub,
  Mubarak Collection and Gujarat Food Products.
- **Product Engineer — Ruby CRM** (Jun 2025 – Present, https://www.rubycrm.ai)
  Delivered 50+ core features across frontend, backend services, integrations
  and platform improvements. Worked on lead management, property listings,
  portal syndication and WhatsApp integration.
- **Product Engineer — Beem Cards** (Jan 2025 – Present, https://beem.cards)
  Leading full-stack development of Beem Cards, a scalable digital smart card
  platform for professional networking, built with Django, PostgreSQL, React,
  Next.js and TypeScript.
